d:
'apna desh paraye log' ek behatrin hindi drama philm hai jo bhavnatmak sangharsh, vyaktigat tyag aur samajik chunautiyon ko darshati hai. apne parivar ke samman aur priyajnon ki raksha ke lie anyay ke khilaph larne vale naykon ki is romanchak kahani ka aanand len. sadabhar sangit, ekshan aur drama se bharpur yah philm avashy dekhen.
Movie : Apna Desh Paraye Log (1989)
Cast: Sumeet Saigal, Moon Moon Sen, Suresh Oberoi, Sadashiv Amrapurkar, Raza Murad, Ashok Saraf, Om Shivpuri, Anjana Mumtaz
Director: Pradeep Hooda
Writer: Armaan Shahabi
Music Director: Usha Khanna
Producer: D.K. Chawla
